eventsource.name: EventSource
eventsource.use: Server-sent events for swift-huggingface (linked, unused by Murmur)

fluidaudio.name: FluidAudio
fluidaudio.note: Links the prebuilt NemoTextProcessing.xcframework (text-processing-rs v0.3.1, Apache-2.0), whose notices are included. Its transitive Rust crates (MIT and/or Apache-2.0) are summarized upstream rather than listed one by one. FluidAudio's resource bundle also carries a LuxTTS pronunciation lexicon that Murmur doesn't use; FluidAudio's documentation says it was harvested from espeak-ng output. FluidAudio publishes it under Apache-2.0 and states it has no GPL dependencies.

grdb.swift.name: GRDB.swift
grdb.swift.use: SQLite database for History, the dictionary and snippets

mlx-swift.name: MLX Swift
mlx-swift.use: Runs the cleanup model on the GPU
mlx-swift.note: Includes MLX and mlx-c (MIT, Apple), {fmt} (MIT), nlohmann/json (MIT) and metal-cpp (Apache-2.0, Apple).

mlx-swift-lm.name: MLX Swift LM
mlx-swift-lm.use: Loads and runs the cleanup language model
mlx-swift-lm.note: Includes XGrammar (Apache-2.0), which includes picojson (BSD-2-Clause) and DLPack (Apache-2.0).

swift-argument-parser.name: Swift Argument Parser
swift-argument-parser.use: Command-line options for murmur-cli and murmur-bench

swift-collections.name: Swift Collections
swift-collections.use: Data structures used by the packages above

swift-crypto.name: Swift Crypto
swift-crypto.use: Dependency of swift-huggingface (a thin layer over Apple's CryptoKit on macOS)
swift-crypto.note: BoringSSL, which swift-crypto carries for other platforms, isn't compiled into Murmur.

swift-huggingface.name: Swift Hugging Face
swift-huggingface.use: Downloads the cleanup model from Hugging Face

swift-jinja.name: Swift Jinja
swift-jinja.use: Chat templates for the cleanup model

swift-numerics.name: Swift Numerics
swift-numerics.use: Math used by the packages above

swift-syntax.name: Swift Syntax
swift-syntax.use: Builds the Swift macros used by MLX Swift LM (build time only)

swift-transformers.name: Swift Transformers
swift-transformers.use: Tokenizers for the cleanup and Whisper models
